_comment: P5 regression budgets (ADR-0028, ADR-0029), operator decision 2026-09-25. Reference machine: RX 6800 / i7-11700K / 32 GB, 1920x1080 offscreen, vsync off. The ~34 ms unload hitch (engine level removal) is ACCEPTED DEBT; it may not become materially worse. A budget is raised only with an operator decision.

navInvokersOnly.why: localized navigation is canonical (ADR-0029); whole-cell navigation is prohibited

emergencyChunks.why: the next cell's ground is always ready before Zenny reaches it

worstFrameMs.why: the accepted ~34 ms authored-level unload hitch, plus under 20% headroom

memGrowthMb.why: P7: 8 round trips between the cells in the real game level off (measured growth ~100 MB after the first round trip); a per-round-trip leak (~0.5 GB each in the editor automation world) cannot fit

navFullBuildSeconds.why: localized initial navigation (P5: 0.53 s; whole-cell 7.64 s)
